title: The Canvas Hour
tagline: One Hour of Silent Creative Painting & Collective Storytelling
description: Participants gather in quiet focus to paint on miniature wooden canvases with provided watercolor sets. At the end of the hour, our AI poet weaves a collective story inspired by everyone's brushstrokes.
